panel.title: Devices on this line
panel.intro: TVs signed in to this line with Snow Media Center. Pick them, choose a message and send it: it pops up on their screen.
panel.quickBusy: Too many people are on this line right now — please stop for a bit.
panel.quickSwitch: Please switch to the other account.
panel.quickSignOut: Please sign out of this line on your TV.
panel.pickMessage: Pick a message or write your own.
panel.rateLimited: That's a lot of messages. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
panel.notOwner: Only this line's owner can message its devices.
panel.notSignedIn: Sign in to the Snow Media account that owns this line to message its devices.
panel.sendFailed: The message didn't go through. Try again.
panel.noDevices: No TVs have signed in to this line yet.
panel.noEmailIntro: This line has no email on file, so its TVs can't be messaged straight from here. Pick a message and Snow Media support will send it to the TVs on this line for you.
panel.supportSent: Sent to support. They'll pass it on to the TVs on this line.

admin.intro: Type a line's username and pick its server to see the TVs signed in to it and message them.
